as_told.title: AUTEC weapons training facility with underwater cables in the Bahamas

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about AUTEC, a US Navy undersea testing and weapons training site in the Bahamas near Nassau, and says there are tons of rumors about it. In another episode he adds that there are underwater cables there that nobody can say where they lead. He raises it because the rumors suggest unknown craft or hidden activity moving under the sea.
